name: Vector Biology and Parasitology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
summary: Vector Biology and Parasitology research PhD; central US-citizenship rule conflicts with department US-degree international exception.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application and supporting documents
publishedDeadlines.note: Central page gives recurring date without entry year; optional GRE policy is explicitly for2026–27 admissions.

applicationFee.note: No application fee and no tuition; no waiver required.

documents: Three recommendation letters sent directly by recommenders
Personal statement on public-health interest and use of training in future career
Parent-organization sponsorship status for active-duty applicants
requirements.note: Master’s in an appropriate biological field normally required; bachelor’s-only entry exceptional. Central admissions requires US citizenship and makes GRE optional for2026–27, but department admissions mentions GRE and international applicants with a US bachelor’s degree. Confirm program-specific citizenship and GRE eligibility before applying. Active-duty relevant officers receive preference; civilians reviewed as space permits, with preference for health professionals sponsored by other US agencies.

funding.note: Tuition and fees waived for all students. Limited civilian predoctoral teaching/research assistantship stipends are available; no universal stipend guarantee stated. The same department Financial Support–Civilian section also describes salary/benefits as government employees for Civilian Track students during the first three years and grant/fellowship support thereafter, while its Admissions section calls civilian stipends limited; confirm the applicable track/package. Military support remains through sponsoring service, with service obligations determined by that service.

international.note: Conflict: central graduate admissions requires US citizenship, while program page considers international students with a US college/university bachelor’s. Confirm applicable policy directly; no general overseas eligibility inferred.
